# FinQA MIT license and benchmark attribution

Upstream: https://github.com/czyssrs/FinQA

Immutable commit: `0f16e2867befa6840783e58be38c9efb9229d742`  
Public test Git blob: `59958c7c3bb3b21f4dff6bc912a0fe0ae710aee0`  
License blob: `fb3b513238ba5ec7e0799cb1190ff30c759a5bdf`

The benchmark vendors only the complete public-test ID/rank inventory plus a deterministic 40-case subset. Development semantic-profile IDs are ranks 1–24; held-out benchmark IDs are ranks 25–64. No FinQA private-test references are used.
